comments.text:
I am 67 yr old female widow with some  dementia progressing into the big Alz 🙃 . Recently In kona Hawaii Safeway at busy after work time , corporate greed had only two human cashiers with long lines . I was not well so I Chose  self checkout to expedite my visit. There were 5 out of 7 people waiting with lights on for assistance due to problems with self checkout . Walmart and Costco have several kind friendly people to help so I did  not expect difficulties at Safeway, our finest , albeit most expensive grocery store . I passed a product through, it stopped requiring me to wait for assistsnce also. One older stressed lady was racing around assisting . When she came to me she began explaining how to type each fruit  and each vegetable into the machine and which buttons to press for weight etc . I explained I could not learn how to type and be a cashier in minutes . I have never been trained snd my memory would not retain her info.  She angrily stated I am showing you now ! Pay attention ! I said I cannot learn how to be a cashier in minutes .  “You have to type each individual  letter of each fruit and vegetable on the screen with correct spelling!” . I became confused . She left . I picked up a Yam but  Safeway sold different types. I did not know which type it was . I had to call her back . She  eas angry again snd told me not to shop in there if I could not be the “cashier “. I would have left but I needed my dinner . I said this is not on you , this is bad management. She insisted  on telling me “ you have to learn this ! “ its your  responsibility to know all food you want !” 
Sir, I recall seeing cashiers  looking up the price of different produce  on paper.  I ask you please , how am  i to know ? For Over  35 years We have been put in water like frogs while corporations have slowly turned ip the heat . I am cooked . Where  is our pay doing this work ? I am on SS income . My cognition snd life is more precious each day. In 1978  I was told to pump my own gas .  I was in a evening dress with my best perfume . I did not know how . A kind gentleman assisted me . 
I refuse to be a sheep . How can I navigate corporate greed today just to buy my groceries please ?
